scope: execplan-implement and all bundled references; planning/delegation dependencies checked for compatibility

contradictions: Mandatory delegation and fresh workers prevented cost-based local execution and context reuse. Replaced with expected completion cost and bounded reuse.
ambiguity: Commit type selection had no matching criteria; added meanings and primary-purpose selection.
Example issue numbers and co-author identity could be copied literally; made placeholder status explicit.
duplication: Removed generic worktree benefits and duplicate commit instructions.
Moved serialized integration procedure behind its execution trigger.
omissions: Added sufficient task packets, concise evidence handback, compaction recovery, local execution, reuse criteria, and explicit no-commit behavior.
Added evals for local cost, shared exploration, worker reuse, and no-commit boundaries.

preserved_obligations: TDD for source changes; appropriate proof for read-only tasks
Shared-document ownership and final coordinated documentation pass through delegate-to-subagents
Private unpushed worker branches; serial integration
Exclusive resolver ownership; affected tests; SHA reconciliation
Clean base and worker trees; fast-forward only; tip equality
Composed behavior proof and unmet acceptance if absent
Safe cleanup preserving unfinished or unrelated work
Conventional commit structure, required sections, trailer policy
intentional_policy_changes: Related-node worker reuse allowed when current context and cost justify it
Conflict resolution can stay local when cheaper
validation_limits: Paper scenarios do not prove real Git/worktree execution
quick_validate.py rejects pre-existing disable-model-invocation key in both versions; retained control
